title: SFT training metrics — descriptive summary
objective: L_SFT = - sum over answer tokens of log p_theta(target token | prompt, previous target tokens); prompt tokens masked with label -100 (completion-only)
cross_objective_warning: SFT cross-entropy and the GRPO policy loss optimize different objectives; their numerical loss values must not be compared directly.
interpretation_boundary: Training loss measures fit to the supervised target tokens, whereas lambda, eta, consistency, and preference preservation are behavioral estimands computed after inference. A lower SFT loss is therefore not itself evidence of lower ownership dependence.
pilot_vs_full: The pilot used a cosine schedule ending at 6,000. The full run used a cosine schedule ending at 30,000. Their step-6,000 weights are not interchangeable.

sft_full_seed1.grad_norm_clipping_note: HF Trainer logs the pre-clipping global gradient norm; the fraction above max_grad_norm is over LOGGED steps only (1 in 10), not all optimizer steps.

learning_rate_schedule.compared_against: linear warmup + cosine decay (HF LambdaLR), evaluated at step-1 to match Trainer logging
learning_rate_schedule.deviation_canonicalization: Deviations below 1e-12 are reported as 0.0 and larger ones are rounded to 6 significant digits; the raw values are floating-point noise whose exact magnitude varies with the NumPy/BLAS build.

full_grid_scan.pilot_exclusion_mechanism: structural: the seed-1 pilot evaluations were moved into baselines/pilot6k/ on 2026-08-06 so they cannot occupy the flat full-run names, and this non-recursive scan cannot reach them.

behavioral.statement: The two full SFT runs have completed training, but their behavioral checkpoint grid has not been evaluated. Therefore, no full-run lambda/eta trajectory is available.

pilot_trajectory.provenance_note: The July-27 evaluation logs record the adapter path as checkpoints/sft_qwen_delta_seed1/checkpoint-N. The pilot trained into that path on July 26 and was renamed to *_pilot6k before the full run reused the name on July 29, so those logs refer to the PILOT adapters. Directory mtimes and the pilot's own manifest (max_steps=6000) confirm the identity. On 2026-08-06 the pilot's evaluation outputs were moved from the flat baselines/ names into baselines/pilot6k/ so a full-run evaluation cannot resume from them and silently return pilot numbers; see that directory's PROVENANCE.md.
